place.en: The Zhang deeps · Before the cauldron

setup.zh: 冀鼎从河床里升起来，比你高。鼎身上铸着山川、走兽、飞鸟——冀州的一切。它在等一个装得下它的人。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Ji rises from the riverbed, taller than you. Cast on its body are mountains, rivers, beasts and birds — everything of Ji. It is waiting for someone who can hold it.

recap.zh: 冀鼎升起，三道雷落进丹田——你筑基了。
recap.en: The Cauldron of Ji rose and three bolts fell into your dantian — you laid your Foundation.

label.en: Take the cauldron's breath · Lay the Foundation

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气扑到你身上又退开。修为未到，装不下。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your cultivation is not yet enough to hold it. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 三道雷从无云的天上落下来，落在你身上，落进丹田。你站住了。鼎小了，小到能握在掌心。
text.en: Three bolts fall from a cloudless sky, into you, into your dantian. You stay standing. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm.
The Foundation is laid. Your hand is shaking.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 它等了两千年，不差你这几天。
text.en: It has waited two thousand years; a few days of yours are nothing.
